_comment: Advisories we have SEEN, JUDGED and DEFERRED - not ones we are ignoring.
scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory that is NOT
listed here, and ALSO fails once an entry's `until` date passes. That second
rule is the point of the file: a deferral has to be renewed deliberately, so
it cannot rot into a permanent exemption that nobody re-reads.
Adding an entry is a decision. Record why, and who has to do what to remove it.

allow.why: Fix requires sharp >=0.35, a major bump of the rasteriser. Every published sheet's bytes are a product guarantee, so the upgrade needs a full re-render and re-baseline (npm run verify) before it can ship - see the Dockerfile's sharp note. Deferred to the P1 block of technical-audit_2026-08-19, NOT waived.
allow.removeBy: Upgrade sharp, re-run npm run verify, re-baseline and re-publish the affected sheets. The written rule is that a security patch outranks byte continuity: a re-baseline is a normal event, not a failure.
allow.exposure: libvips parses image data. The portal only ever feeds it SVG this system generated itself; it never rasterises a file supplied by a customer or a visitor.
